Method [id=—]` 定义机制：Based on the mechanistic perspective developed in Section 3, we propose SinkRouter, a training-free, plug-and-play selective routing framework for long-context decoding. Before loading the historical KV cache, SinkRouter estimates whether the current KV group is likely to enter a sink-dominant, low-impact regime. If so, it skips historical KV-cache loading and replaces the corresponding attention output with a cheap surrogate; otherwise, it falls back to standard attention. In this way, SinkRouter uses sink-related behavior as an execution-time signal for decoding acceleration. A central design principle of SinkRouter is that all routing decisions are made at the KV-group level.
